text: [x]Rush. After this attacks a minion and survives, deal this minion's Attack damage split among all enemies.

abilities.span: After this attacks a minion and survives, deal this minion's Attack damage split among all enemies.

dependencies.detail: 'split among' without 'randomly' is encoded as randomly split (R_SPLIT_UNQUALIFIED); the independent rules check did not confirm that equivalence.
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log of Magma Hound's trigger or an authoritative rules source

dependencies.detail: If the attack is redirected after declaration, whether 'attacks a minion' sees the original or the final defender.
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log of a redirected Magma Hound attack

decisions.question: Who attacks?
decisions.discriminating_case: Your hero attacks with a weapon while Hound is in play: no trigger under 'this minion'.

decisions.question: How is the damage split?
alternatives: randomly split: one random live enemy per 1-damage packet
decisions.chosen: randomly split: one random live enemy per 1-damage packet
decisions.discriminating_case: Two enemy 1-Health minions and 2 Attack: under random split both can survive the second packet hitting the hero; a chosen distribution kills both.

decisions.question: When is this minion's Attack read?
alternatives: Attack when the attack was declared
decisions.discriminating_case: A combat reaction that changes Hound's Attack changes the number of packets.

notes: CARD-IR-V02 expressivity example: the trigger is fully structured; PARTIAL only because the unqualified split reading is unconfirmed (CORE).
